user.title: Set up ESPHome MCP Bridge
user.description:
This exposes the **ESPHome Builder** LLM API to AI agents through Home Assistant's MCP server, covering the full ESPHome development cycle (inventory, read/write YAML, validate, compile, upload, run, logs).

An ESPHome dashboard add-on (stable, beta, or dev) must be installed. Select **Submit** to enable it.

data_description.allow_extra_files: Let agents read, create, and write files other than .yaml/.yml and use subdirectory paths (e.g. C++ in a custom components/ directory). secrets.yaml stays protected and files can never leave /config/esphome. Leave off if you only edit device YAML. You can change this later in the integration options.

abort.single_instance_allowed: ESPHome MCP Bridge is already configured. Only one instance is needed.
